# Tariq (p16) journal — BodyTracker

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Setup was quick. Filled 183 cm, 36, 96 kg, male, picked "Lightly active" (desk job, gym sometimes). Said "Yes" to eating like this for 2+ weeks.
- The weight I typed in the profile became today's weigh-in automatically (96 kg in Recent entries) — nice, didn't have to enter it twice. Wasn't sure at first if I still had to add it.
- Target first showed 2,650 "maintain". Had to dig: the goal (Lose) is hidden behind the ⚙ on the Nutrition tab, not in the profile setup. Expected the setup to ask me what I want. After Lose @0.5%/wk: target 2,160, maintenance 2,650 ± 620 "Estimated".
- Food log: two buttons both say "Add entry" (a heading and the button) — fine once you know.
- Dinner I only knew kcal + protein. After that the Day total dropped carbs/fat entirely ("2090 kcal · 125 g protein") instead of showing the known part. Minor, a bit odd.
- Logged 4 meals = 2,090 kcal, ticked Day complete. Protein 125 vs 173 g target — that's a lot of protein.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- Tapped "Weight" on the home card expecting to add a weight — it opened the Weight trend chart instead. The add button is the "+ Weight" one. Small confusion.
- 95.1 kg. Home shows ▼0.9 kg, trend 95.9.
- Food log said "Macros add up to ~728 kcal (16% from the logged calories). One of the numbers may be off." on my labneh breakfast. That's just the label numbers I copied, not a typo. OK to know it checks though.
- 2,377 kcal logged, day complete. Above the 2,160 target (mandi…).

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 96.0 kg again (up from 95.1). Home shows "• 0 kg" — compared to first weigh-in I guess. Trend 95.9.
- Recommendation still says "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" even though it's my 3rd day. Confusing — I guess it only refreshes on Sunday, but the "day 1 so far" reads like it didn't count my days.
- 2,231 kcal logged, complete. Avg intake 2,233.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- 96.2 kg. Home arrow shows ▲0.2 kg (yesterday it said "• 0 kg" when I was 96 = start). Not sure if the arrow is vs first weigh-in or vs yesterday — there's a "vs First / vs Last" switch at the top which I haven't touched.
- 2,219 kcal logged, complete. Still averaging ~2,230, i.e. ~70 over target. Scale not moving yet.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 95.1 kg. Big 1,000 kcal lunch; day = 2,539 kcal. Avg now 2,291 vs 2,160 target. App doesn't say anything about me being over target yet (just shows the numbers side by side).

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 94.7 kg, ▼1.3 kg (so the arrow is vs my first weigh-in). Trend 95.7. 2,321 kcal, complete.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 94.7 kg. Burger at lunch: no idea of macros, just typed kcal — app shows "no macros", fine. Protein average then ignores that day ("6 logged days"). Makes sense.
- 2,437 kcal, complete. 7/7 days complete.

## Week 1 (checked Sat evening, day 7)
- Nutrition tab: maintenance 2,650 ± 620 "Estimated, 0% from your data". Target 2,160 (lose 0.5%/wk). Avg intake 2,316 over 7 days. Protein 158 vs 173 g.
- "Explain the math" is a wall of formulas (Hall 2008, Forbes, MAD…). I skimmed. What I got: the 2,650 is just a formula from my height/weight/age × activity, and my own data counts 0% until the Sunday update. The target is formula minus ~500 kcal.
- Odd: Section 8 says "Cross-check not available: needs ≥ 7 weigh-ins in the last 28 days" — I have 7 weigh-ins. Probably because the numbers are frozen from the 10-04 update, but it reads wrong.
- My take: I'm eating ~150 over target on average. Scale went 96 → 94.7 anyway (probably water). No warnings shown. I'll wait for tomorrow's weekly update before changing anything.

## Day 8 (Sun) — first weekly update
- After the update: maintenance 2,760 ± 590 (Estimated, 12% from my data), target 2,270, trend -0.44 kg/wk (95%: -1.02 to +0.14). Protein target 172 g.
- So my maintenance went UP by 110 and my target too. I'm averaging 2,309, so basically on target. Decided: trim a little, plan ~2,250.
- Logged 2,039 today, complete.

## Day 9 (Mon) — from here I use a script (still taps through the app)
- 94.2 kg, 2,311 kcal.

## Day 10 (Tue) — TYPO #1: weight 9.6 instead of 95
- In a hurry I typed 9.6. On Save the form stayed open and said "That value looks out of range — please check it." Nothing was saved.
- CAUGHT: yes, immediately, before saving. Fixed it by retyping 95 in the same form. Numbers never affected (Recent entries shows only 95 kg for 10-13). Screenshot: screens/1790454965951.png

## Days 11–14
- Normal. Weights 95.0, 95.4, 95.2, 94.3. Intake 2,719 / 2,365 / 2,528 / 2,153, all complete.

## Day 15 (Sun 10-18) — MISSED
- I didn't open the app at all that day (my own slip — my helper script rolled the day over without me logging). No weigh-in, no food. The app shows "10-18 not logged" and just treats it as unknown — no nagging, no gap warning. I didn't backfill because I don't remember what I ate.

## Week 2 (checked Mon 10-19, day 16, after Sunday update)
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.94 to +0.02 kg/week) includes your target of −0.48 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,290 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,780 ± 500, Estimated, 36% from my data. Target 2,290. Avg intake 2,330. Trend −0.46 kg/wk. 5 of last 7 complete (the missed Sunday).
- What I understand: I'm losing roughly what I wanted, keep going. The range "−0.94 to +0.02" means it's not even sure I'm losing at all, which is a bit deflating, but "On track" is clear enough.
- Decision: keep eating ~2,250–2,300. No change.

## Days 16–21
- Weights 95.0, 94.4, 94.5, 94.7, 93.5, 94.0. Intake ~2,180–2,890, all complete. Nothing new popped up.

## Week 3 (Sun 10-25, day 22, after update)
- "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.87 to −0.12 kg/week) includes your target of −0.47 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,330 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,810 ± 390 — now labelled "Measured" (60% from my data). Target 2,330. Avg intake 2,335. Trend −0.49 kg/wk.
- Nice: the range now is all negative, so I'm actually losing. Keep doing what I'm doing. No plan change.

## Days 22–23
- Odd: on Sunday 10-25 morning the update said maintenance 2,810 / target 2,330. After I logged Sunday's food in the evening it changed to 2,770 / 2,290 while still saying "last update 2026-10-25". So the "weekly" numbers can shift during the update day itself. Minor, but I noticed the target changed under me.

## Day 24 (Tue 10-27) — TYPO #2: whole day 2,950 typed as 950
- Big family dinner. Logged the whole day as one entry at night, typed 950 instead of 2950, ticked Day complete.
- App said nothing. No "this looks low" warning, even though every other complete day is 1,900–2,900 and this is a ticked-complete 950 kcal day. Screenshot: screens/1790455378932.png
- Immediate effect: avg intake (14-day) went 2,379 → 2,188. Protein target stuff unaffected (no macros on that entry).
- I didn't notice that night.

## Days 25–28
- 10-28: app showed a banner "macros add up to ~2259 kcal vs 2815 kcal logged (20% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I checked — those are just the label numbers I copied (restaurant food), nothing to fix. Funny that it flagged this real day but never flagged my 950 day.
- Weights 93.9, 93.8, 93.6, 94.1.
- During these days the "avg intake" on the Nutrition tab sat at 2,128–2,278 — lower than I really ate, because of the 950 day. I didn't notice.

## Week 4 (Sun 11-01, day 29) — found TYPO #2
- Weekly update (with the 950 still in): "On track. Estimated rate −1.16 to +0.32 kg/week… Suggested intake 2,300." Maintenance 2,780 ± 350, Measured 68%. Avg intake 2,007 kcal/day (!), trend −0.42.
- The 2,007 avg jumped out at me — I don't eat that little. Scrolled the "Last 14 days" list and saw "10-27 1 entry | 950 kcal complete". Right, the family dinner, should be 2,950.
- Fix: tapped the 10-27 row → Food log for that date → Edit → changed 950 to 2950 → Save changes. Easy, 4 taps. Screenshot: screens/1790455536172.png
- After the fix, everything recalculated straight away: maintenance 2,810 ± 320 (73% from data), target 2,330, avg intake 2,340, trend −0.36, rate −1.05 to +0.33.
- So the typo cost: target was 30 kcal too low (2,300 vs 2,330) and maintenance 30 lower at the weekly update; avg intake shown ~190–330 too low for 5 days. Not a disaster, but the app never warned me — I only caught it because the average looked too good.
- Decision: still "On track", keep eating ~2,300. No plan change.

## Days 29–30
- After logging Sunday's food the numbers moved again: maintenance 2,830 ± 310 (75%), target 2,350, avg 2,354, rate −0.95 to +0.02. "On track".

## Day 31 (Tue 11-03) — backup nag + TYPO #3: lunch logged twice
- On opening: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Tapped Back up now → Your data screen → Full backup (JSON). Got bodytracker-backup-2026-11-03.json. Fine, but "30+ days since your last backup" when I've never backed up is slightly off wording.
- Logged lunch (832 kcal kabsa) twice by accident, 2 minutes apart, identical label & numbers. The app accepted the duplicate with no "you already logged this" check.
- At dinner time I opened the Food log and the day total was already 2,478 kcal before dinner — that made me look, saw two identical "832 kcal · Lunch" rows. Tapped the second one's Delete → "Delete this entry?" OK → total back to 1,646. Found and fixed same day, before ticking Day complete, so no effect on the weekly numbers.
- Caught by app: no. Found by me: yes (only because the day total looked too high).

## Days 32–35
- Weights 93.2, 91.8, 91.6, 93.6 (that last one is a jump, restaurant dinner the night before I guess). Nothing new shown. The 10-28 macros banner dropped off by itself.

## Week 5 (Sun 11-08, day 36)
- "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.70 to −0.19 kg/week) includes your target of −0.47. Suggested intake 2,330."
- Maintenance 2,800 ± 260, Measured 82%. Target 2,330. Avg 2,268. Trend −0.44 kg/wk. Protein 149 vs 169 g (always a bit short on protein).
- Understood: I'm losing about half a kilo a week. Happy. Keep going, no change.

## Days 36–42
- Sunday 11-08 evening, after I logged the day (weight 91.7): maintenance jumped 2,800 → 3,010 and target 2,330 → 2,530 on the same "last update 2026-11-08". Then on TUESDAY 11-10 (not an update day) the numbers changed again to 2,970 / 2,490, still labelled "last update 2026-11-08, next 2026-11-15". The screen says it only refreshes weekly, but it moved mid-week. Screenshots around screens/1790455*.png (day 38).
- Explain the math (day 42) said 3 of my weigh-ins (11-05 91.8, 11-06 91.6, 11-08 91.7) were "set aside by the filter because they were more than 4 standard deviations from its prediction". Those were real readings from my scale — I did drop that low for a few days. The app quietly threw them out; I wasn't told on the Body screen.
- Weights 92.1, 93.1, 93.3, 93.4, 93.3, 92.3. One big day (3,143 kcal on 11-12).
- I thought about eating more because target said 2,490, but didn't bother changing anything.

## Week 6 (Sun 11-15, day 43)
- "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.66 to −0.35 kg/week) includes your target of −0.47. Suggested intake 2,350."
- Maintenance 2,830 ± 170, Measured 93%. Target 2,350. Avg 2,381. Trend −0.50.
- So the 2,490–2,530 in the middle of the week was a blip and it's back to 2,350. Good thing I didn't start eating more. Keep going as is.

## Days 43–49
- Weights 92.5, 93.2, 92.6, 93.3, 92.8, 92.5, 92.4. Ate a bit less this week (~1,760–2,300). Nothing new popped up; numbers stayed put all week this time.

## Week 7 (Sun 11-22, day 50)
- "On track. Estimated rate (−0.66 to −0.36 kg/week) includes your target of −0.46. Suggested intake 2,290."
- Maintenance 2,770 ± 160, Measured 93%. Target 2,290. Avg 2,068. Trend −0.51. Protein 131 vs 167 — I'm short on protein, should add a shake maybe.
- No change needed; I'm slightly under target, which is fine for me.

## Days 50–56
- Weights 91.5, 91.8, 91.8, 91.3, 91.8, 91.8, 90.8. Intake ~1,660–2,550. Quiet week, no pop-ups.

## Week 8 (Sun 11-29, day 57)
- First time NOT "On track": "Your estimated rate (−0.83 to −0.53 kg per week) doesn't include your target of −0.46 kg/week. Eating about 220 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,380 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 2,840 ± 160, Measured 94%. Target 2,380. Avg 2,184. Trend −0.68 kg/wk.
- Funny to be told to eat MORE when I'm trying to lose, but it's clear: I'm losing faster than the 0.5% I picked. Decision: add a protein shake (~150 kcal) → plan 2,350. Also helps my protein which is always ~20 g short.

## Days 57–63
- Weights 91.3, 92.0, 91.4, 90.4, 90.6, 90.3, 91.3. Tried to eat a bit more; avg didn't move much (~2,200).
- Day 61 (12-03): backup nag again ("30+ days since your last backup"). Correct this time. Backed up on day 64 (bodytracker-backup-2026-12-06.json).

## Week 9 (Sun 12-06, day 64)
- "Your estimated rate (−0.78 to −0.48 kg/week) doesn't include your target of −0.46. Eating about 180 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake 2,380."
- Maintenance 2,840 ± 160, Measured 94%. Target 2,380. Avg 2,243. Trend −0.63.
- It's right that I haven't actually been eating more. Plan 2,400 — bigger lunches.

## Days 64–70
- Weights 91.0, 91.6, 90.8, 91.3, 92.0, 91.9, 92.0. I ate more like the app said — maybe too much (2,400–3,000; Saturday 3,016).

## Week 10 (Sun 12-13, day 71)
- Flip: "Your estimated rate (−0.40 to −0.09 kg/week) doesn't include your target of −0.46. Eating about 220 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake 2,230."
- Maintenance dropped 2,840 → 2,690 ± 160 (Measured 94%). Target 2,230. Avg 2,616. Trend −0.24.
- Annoying whiplash: last week "eat more", this week "eat less" and my maintenance number fell 150 kcal in one week. Fair though — I overshot (ate ~2,550 instead of 2,380). Plan 2,230.

## Days 71–77
- Weights 90.5, 90.7, 90.9, 92.0, 90.7, 90.6, 90.6. Back to ~2,100–2,370.
- 12-14 macros banner again ("~2856 vs 2367 logged, 21% apart"). Checked the entries — they match what the labels said. Nothing to fix; I can't dismiss the banner, it just sits at the top for a week.

## Week 11 (Sun 12-20, day 78)
- "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.96 to +0.35 kg/week) includes your target of −0.46. Suggested intake 2,270."
- Maintenance 2,730 ± 170, Measured 92%. Target 2,270. Avg 2,167. Trend −0.30.
- "On track" but the range now includes gaining (+0.35)?? Two weeks ago it was a tight −0.83 to −0.53. Confusing — "on track" feels like a stretch when it can't tell if I'm losing. I'll keep ~2,250.

## Days 78–84
- Sunday 12-20: morning said "On track… suggested 2,270". After I logged Sunday's food/weight in the evening it flipped to: "Your estimated rate (−0.44 to +0.46 kg/week) doesn't include your target of −0.46 kg/week. Eating about 460 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,260 kcal/day." My recent avg was ~2,167 (later 1,902). Eating 460 less than that = ~1,700, which is below the app's own "minimum suggested 1,881". But the suggested number (2,260) is MORE than I've been eating. The sentence and the number contradict each other. Screenshot: screens/1790457069377.png. The math page says "closing the gap needs about 465 kcal/day less" — so it's computed from the weight rate, not from my intake.
- Also the range −0.44 to +0.46 misses my target by 0.02 kg/week, yet the message reads like a big problem ("460 less").
- Weights 90.8, 89.9, 90.7, 91.1, 90.2, 89.9 — lowest yet on the last day. 6 kg down in 12 weeks.

## End tasks
- Full backup: bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json (83 weigh-ins, 329 food entries, settings). Opened it: readable JSON. Small oddity: inside the backup, "lastBackupAt" says 2026-12-06 (the previous one), and its timestamp is UTC while the daily export uses my local time.
- Daily export (All data, with food entries): bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. My fixes are in it: 10-13 weight 95, 10-27 = 2,950 kcal, 11-03 lunch only once. Days where one entry had no carbs/fat have no carbs/fat total at all for the day. The 3 weigh-ins the filter "set aside" aren't marked in the export.

## Final review
Honestly it did its job — I'm 6 kg down (96 → 89.9) and logging took me a minute per meal. What helped: the weekly number that doesn't jump daily (mostly), "On track" in plain words, and the out-of-range check that stopped my 9.6 kg typo on the spot. What bugged me: the app never noticed I logged a 950 kcal "complete" day when I normally eat 2,300 — I only found it because the average looked too good, and it quietly lowered my numbers for five days. It also let me log the same lunch twice two minutes apart without a word. The goal setting is hidden behind a gear icon, the "weekly" numbers still changed on a Sunday evening and once on a Tuesday, and the last recommendation told me to eat 460 less while suggesting a number higher than what I eat. The "Explain the math" page is for scientists, not me. Would keep using: yes, but I'd double-check my own entries because the app won't.

# p16 (Tariq) — final report

## 1. Usage
- Days I used the app: 83 of 84. I missed day 15 (Sun 10-18) completely because my helper script moved to the next day before I'd logged anything. That was my slip, not the app's. The app just showed that day as "not logged".
- Meals logged: 329 food entries, mostly 4 a day. On one day I logged the whole day as a single entry.
- Days marked complete: 83.
- Weigh-ins: 83. The first one came from the profile. Weight went from 96.0 to 89.9 kg.

## 2. Weekly table
| week (day) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (d7→d8 update) | 2,650 ± 620 → 2,760 ± 590 | 2,160 → 2,270 | Estimated (0% → 12%) | Suggested 2,270. The on-track check needs 14 days | plan 2,250 (trim snacks) |
| 2 (d16) | 2,780 ± 500 | 2,290 | Estimated 36% | On track (−0.94 to +0.02) | no change |
| 3 (d22) | 2,810 ± 390 | 2,330 | Measured 60% | On track (−0.87 to −0.12) | no change |
| 4 (d29) | 2,780 ± 350 with the typo; 2,810 ± 320 after I fixed it | 2,300 → 2,330 | Measured 68→73% | On track | found and fixed the 950 typo |
| 5 (d36) | 2,800 ± 260. That evening it jumped to 3,010, and on Tuesday it was 2,970 | 2,330 (then 2,530, then 2,490) | Measured 82% | On track | no change |
| 6 (d43) | 2,830 ± 170 | 2,350 | Measured 93% | On track | no change |
| 7 (d50) | 2,770 ± 160 | 2,290 | Measured 93% | On track | no change |
| 8 (d57) | 2,840 ± 160 | 2,380 | Measured 94% | Losing too fast, eat ~220 more | plan 2,350 (added a protein shake) |
| 9 (d64) | 2,840 ± 160 | 2,380 | Measured 94% | Still too fast, eat ~180 more | plan 2,400 |
| 10 (d71) | 2,690 ± 160 | 2,230 | Measured 94% | Too slow, eat ~220 less | plan 2,230 |
| 11 (d78) | 2,730 ± 170 → 2,720 | 2,270 → 2,260 | Measured 92% | Morning: On track. Evening: "eat 460 less", suggested 2,260 | no change (confused) |

## 3. Typos: did the app catch them, could I fix them, and what did they do to the numbers?
- **Day 10, weight typed as 9.6 instead of 95:**
  - Caught: yes, straight away. It said "That value looks out of range — please check it" and saved nothing.
  - Fix: I retyped 95 in the same form.
  - Effect on numbers: none.
- **Day 24, whole-day entry typed as 950 instead of 2,950 (day ticked complete):**
  - Caught: no. There was no warning, even though my other complete days were 1,900–2,900.
  - Effect for 5 days: the 14-day average intake showed 2,007–2,278 instead of about 2,340. The weekly update ran with the typo still in, giving maintenance 2,780 and target 2,300 instead of 2,810 and 2,330. So the error was about 30 kcal, with a wider rate range.
  - Found: on day 29, because a 2,007 average looked too low. I scrolled "Last 14 days" and saw "10-27 1 entry 950 kcal".
  - Fix: tapped the row, then Edit, then Save changes. Everything recalculated immediately.
- **Day 31, same lunch (832 kcal) logged twice, 2 minutes apart:**
  - Caught: no duplicate warning.
  - Found: the same day at dinner, because the day total was already 2,478 before dinner.
  - Fix: tapped Delete on the second copy, before ticking complete. No effect on the weekly numbers.

## 4. Confusions
- Profile setup: the goal (Lose) isn't asked. It's hidden behind ⚙ on the Nutrition tab, so the first target shown was "maintain 2,650".
- Home screen: tapping "Weight" opens the trend chart. To add a weigh-in you need the "+ Weight" button.
- Recommendation during week 1: "needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" stayed the same on days 2–7.
- Food log: the heading and the button are both called "Add entry".
- Food log: if one entry has no carbs or fat, the day total drops the carbs/fat for the whole day.
- Explain the math, week 1: "Cross-check not available: needs ≥7 weigh-ins", even though I had 7.
- Explain the math in general: all formulas (Kalman, Hall/Forbes, MAD). No plain-language summary.
- Rate range: "On track" in week 11 while the range was −0.96 to +0.35, which includes gaining.
- Macro-mismatch banner: it keeps flagging real label numbers for a week and can't be dismissed.
- Backup nag: the first one said "30+ days since your last backup" when I had never backed up.

## 5. Possible bugs
1. **A 950 kcal day ticked complete is accepted without any warning.**
   - Steps: log one 950 kcal entry for the whole day on a day that should be ~2,950, then tick Day complete.
   - Expected: a "this looks unusually low" prompt, given 3 weeks of 1,900–2,900 kcal days. The weight form does warn about out-of-range values.
   - Actual: nothing. The average and the weekly estimate were skewed until I found it myself.
